content:
Alex Kim: Quick sync: we need a lightweight "evidence+disclosure" workflow for marketplace listings. scope: SOC artifacts, pen reports, SI questionnaire, upload paths, and a one-line allowed public copy. goal: publish guidance for partners before kickoff next week.
Rebecca Liu: Sounds good. SOC status: our hosted SOC2 expires 2026-07-15. can we add a small FAQ about what counts as proof (full report vs attestation letter)?
Priya Rao: Legal prefers attestation + scope note in most cases. full SOC2 can be uploaded to the redaction bucket if partner signs NDA. otherwise we accept the attestation PDF + evidence of remediation timelines.
Mike O'Connor: pen-test cadence: suggest we offer two options: 1) partners reuse a recent third-party pen test within 6 months, or 2) schedule a new short-run test aligned with our vendor window. vendors we trust: SecCheck Labs, NightScan. estimated lead time 10 business days.
Sara Patel: upload plan: use s3 bucket: redwood-marketplace-evidence-prod. folder pattern: partners/{partner}/{listing}/{artifact_kind}/{yyyyMMdd-HHMMSS}-{shortid}. recommended TTL on presign links: 72h. metadata keys: partner_name, listing_id, artifact_kind, owner_email, redaction_status. example curl for upload with presigned URL:
```
curl -X PUT -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @pen-report.json "https://s3-presigned-url"
```
Sara Patel: redaction minimal: strip PII, mask customer IDs, remove internal-only DNS names, replace full IPs with ranges (e.g., 10.0.0.0/8 -> <internal-range>), and include a redaction_notes.txt alongside the artifact.
Jordan Lee: SI questionnaire: i'll draft a single-page form with checkboxes + short text fields: deployment_type, data_paths, credentials_handling, third_party_services, pen_test_reference, SOC_reference, contact_person. include a reusable blurb partners can paste into their press rollout.
Alex Kim: add roles: Rebecca = SOC guidance + FAQ, Mike = pen-test scheduling + vendor contacts, Sara = upload/presign + redaction checklist + sample script, Jordan = SI questionnaire + announcement blurb, Priya = legal signoff on disclosure. i'll assemble the playbook.
Rebecca Liu: FAQ snippet: "Acceptable evidence: (a) current SOC2 attestation PDF; (b) full SOC2 report with NDA; (c) third-party pen-test summary plus remediation confirmation. All artifacts must indicate scope/cvg of hosted vs dedicated/private."
Mike O'Connor: Proposed vendor slot: 2026-05-18 -> 2026-05-29. allow 5 business days after vendor report for remediation confirmation. i'll reach out to SecCheck to tentatively reserve the window.
Priya Rao: Disclosure one-liner (legal): "This integration uses Redwood Inference; security controls and deployment terms are available on request." keep it short and non-committal.
Sara Patel: sample metadata payload for partners to PUT as JSON after upload:
```
{
  "partner_name":"greystone",
  "listing_id":"rlw-2026",
  "artifact_kind":"pen-test",
  "owner_email":"pm@greystone.com",
  "redaction_status":"true"
}
```
Alex Kim: timeline: draft playbook by Mon (2876544000), internal review Tue, vendor + SI kickoff Fri. does that timeline work?
Jordan Lee: timeline OK pending partner PM ack. i'll ping Greystone PM now.
Rebecca Liu: i will attach attestation + attestation summary. note: mark which controls cover dedicated/private variations.
Mike O'Connor: confirming vendor outreach. any objections to 72h presign TTL?
Sara Patel: 72h is fine. but require partners to upload within 24h of receiving link to avoid stale links. we'll add a script that retries and verifies hash after upload.
ComplianceBot: Reminder: SOC2 expiry for redwood-inference-hosted = 2026-07-15. Action item: start renewal outreach at 90 days prior. Logged by ComplianceBot.
Alex Kim: ok team, please drop your one-paragraph sections into the shared playbook doc in partnership drive by EOD Mon. i'll compile and route to Security + Legal. thanks :rocket:
